_notes: Source: GAME_DESIGN.md section 6. Batteries (Phase 2): a drone's daily flying = batteries x flightMinutesPerBattery; a job's flight (incl. any refill trip) uses that much charge, and every drone recharges fully each morning (balance.json batteries.rechargeHour). A 'battery' here is a day-sized pack sized so the starter 2 batteries cover a typical day of that drone's starter jobs. Values in _picked were chosen by Claude as placeholders (Oscar: tweak freely). Everything else is from GAME_DESIGN.md or Oscar's Phase 1 answers.

drones.name: Enterprise (Media) Drone
drones.notes: Cheapest, steady low-pay work, all seasons

drones.name: Spray Drone
drones.notes: Summer heavy. Long flights, little/no render. Needs chemical refills. Grounded in wind like the other drones. Chemicals cost 30% of job pay; every job adds a 1h refill trip.

drones.name: LiDAR Drone
drones.notes: Biggest pay, huge render times, needs high rep for best contracts
